card.name: Whether introducing an open question
card.fires_on: The word whether (or if) that opens an indirect yes/no question, often right before 'or not'. Also nearby words inside such a clause, like 'like' in 'whether people like'.

modes.label: Whether / if clause
modes.description: 'whether' or 'if' follows a verb or preposition and opens an undecided question.
modes.example: Distance of pages from the root directory of a site may also be a factor in<< whether>> or not pages get crawled.

modes.label: Inside the whether clause
modes.description: A word within the clause or a question opener that continues the open question.
modes.example: nature has a way of balancing itself out, whether people<< like>> the results or not."

modes.label: Question-leading word
modes.description: A bullet that starts a question with 'Is'.
modes.example: •<< Is>> the word Data singular or plural?

card.writes: It favors words that continue a either/or or direct-question phrasing, like 'ever', 'either' and 'directly'.
card.plain: It lights up on 'whether' or 'if' when a sentence leaves a yes-or-no question open.
